record.question: The following enzymes are all tumor markers, EXCEPT :
record.explanation: Answer C: Amylase. Amylase is not a standard serum tumor marker in the listed conventional panel; PSA, prostatic acid phosphatase and neuron-specific enolase are used as tumor-associated markers. Amylase may be elevated in some pancreatic disease, but that is not equivalent to an established tumor-marker role. Reference: markers. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
